files.purpose: Configure Jac 0.36.1 [project] with entry-point main.jac; this headless slice has no npm or AI dependencies.
Define obj DiagnosisCode with code:str, description:str, category:str, confidence:float default 0.0 and source:str default "symptom_mapper".

signatures.DiagnosisCode: obj DiagnosisCode { has code: str; has description: str; has category: str; has confidence: float = 0.0; has source: str = "symptom_mapper"; }

files.purpose: Define obj ProviderOption with name, specialty, address, phone (str), accepts_insurance:list[str], distance_miles:float=0.0, rating:float=0.0, accepting_new_patients:bool=True, telehealth_available:bool=False, notes:str="".

signatures.ProviderOption: obj ProviderOption { has name: str; has specialty: str; has address: str; has phone: str; has accepts_insurance: list[str]; has distance_miles: float = 0.0; has rating: float = 0.0; has accepting_new_patients: bool = True; has telehealth_available: bool = False; has notes: str = ""; }

files.purpose: Import DiagnosisCode from .codes and ProviderOption from .provider. Define a module-level APP_DISCLAIMER with the same exact text as services/common.jac, obj ChatMessage(role, content, timestamp, agent), objs CareSummary, ConversationStateUpdate, InterventionDecision, DiagnosisResult, CallingPreparation, and node UserSession with session_id, created_at, updated_at, phone_number="", active_agent="Conversation Agent", last_user_message="", list fields transcript, extracted_symptoms, risk_flags, assigned_codes, provider_options, agent_path (default []), bools intervention_active, intervention_resolved, crisis_therapists_shown (default False) and str|None fields symptom_duration, severity, location, insurance, summary_text, doctor_notes (default None). append_message appends ChatMessage(role, content, timestamp=ts, agent) to session.transcript; update_session_timestamp sets only updated_at. session_to_dict returns a dict with exactly these keys: session_id, phone_number, created_at, updated_at, active_agent, transcript, extracted_symptoms, risk_flags, assigned_codes, provider_options, agent_path, agent_trace, intervention_active, intervention_resolved, location, insurance, summary_text, doctor_notes, disclaimer (=APP_DISCLAIMER). transcript items are {"role","content","timestamp","agent"} dicts; assigned_codes items are {"code","description","category","confidence","source"} dicts; provider_options items are {"name","specialty","address","phone","accepts_insurance","distance_miles","rating","accepting_new_patients","telehealth_available","notes"} dicts, each read by attribute from the stored objects. agent_trace is a list of six {"name": str, "status": str} dicts in this order: Intervention Agent/listening, Conversation Agent/idle, Calling Agent/idle, Diagnosis Agent/idle, Messaging Agent/idle, Summary Agent/idle; each agent_path entry is split on ':' and, when it has at least two parts, sets the status of the trace item whose name equals part 0 to part 1; entries without ':' are ignored.

signatures.ChatMessage: obj ChatMessage { has role: str; has content: str; has timestamp: str; has agent: str; }
signatures.UserSession: node UserSession { has session_id: str; has created_at: str; has updated_at: str; ... }
signatures.append_message: def append_message(session: UserSession, role: str, content: str, agent: str, ts: str) -> None
signatures.update_session_timestamp: def update_session_timestamp(session: UserSession, ts: str) -> None

files.purpose: Define glob APP_DISCLAIMER exactly "AnchorCare is an AI-powered care coordination platform. It does not replace emergency care or professional diagnosis." and pure helpers new_session_id (uuid4 string), iso_now (datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()), normalize_text, first_non_empty, merge_strings, truncate and transcript_excerpt (last N messages as 'ROLE: content' lines, accepting dicts or objects).

signatures.first_non_empty: def first_non_empty(a: str, b: str) -> str
signatures.merge_strings: def merge_strings(existing: str, incoming: str) -> str
signatures.truncate: def truncate(text: str, max_chars: int) -> str
signatures.transcript_excerpt: def transcript_excerpt(messages: list, max_messages: int) -> str

files.purpose: Import UserSession from models.session and iso_now, APP_DISCLAIMER from .common. Output contract (exact strings; '—' is an em dash, '·' a middle dot): _escape_html replaces & < > " ' with & < > " ' (ampersand first) and is applied to every user value. _fmt_time(ts) returns the 5 chars after 'T' (HH:MM); _fmt_date(ts) returns the part before 'T'. html_content is the concatenation, with no separators, of: a

Thin entry point that imports UserSession, ChatMessage, append_message, update_session_timestamp and session_to_dict from models.session and build_session_pdf_payload from services.pdf_exporter; no UI route.

verify.flow: build session -> append messages -> serialize -> build PDF payload
verify.steps: Run jac check main.jac and the Jac behavior tests for session helpers, session_to_dict and build_session_pdf_payload.

assumption: Backend slice of push-to-production/CareAnchor (AnchorCare): models and the PDF export service. Agents, components, LLM-backed services and the original UI entry point are out of scope; main.jac is a thin new re-export module.
